# hudu_network (Resource)

Manages a Hudu network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hudu_network" "office" {
  name        = "Office Network"
  address     = "192.168.1.0/24"
  company_id  = hudu_company.acme.id
  description = "Main office local network"
  vlan_id     = hudu_vlan.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Network address in CIDR notation, e.g. `192.168.1.0/24`.
- `company_id` (Number) ID of the owning company.
- `name` (String) Network name.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the network is archived. Archived networks are hidden from the regular Hudu lists but remain retrievable.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the network.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the Hudu location this network belongs to. Server-defaulted if unset.
- `network_type` (Number) Integer code for the network type. Server-defaulted if unset.
- `vlan_id` (Number) ID of the associated `hudu_vlan` resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the network was created, in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-01-15T12:34:56.789Z`).
- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned by Hudu, as a string.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated by Hudu.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the network was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC.
- `url` (String) Absolute URL of the network in the Hudu web UI.
